errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени от най-голям към най-малък по часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged from largest to smallest in a clockwise direction. This is incorrect. Starting from the top, the sectors are 4%, 15%, 20%, and 61%, which is an ascending order, not descending.

The description omits the unit '(в км.)' (in km) which is specified for each road category in the legend (e.g., 'Автомагистрали (в км.)'). This information clarifies that the share is based on the length of the roads.
